acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Golems family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Basalt Colossus, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Orbit-Plate Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Huge black basalt body with source-supported floating plates and molten chest core.
Signature mechanic: Plate Orbit: floating basalt plates widen into a ring, exposing the molten chest core before converging on marked lanes.
battlefieldDuty: Control space by orbiting separated basalt plates between shield wall and crushing ring.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo; T4 alone gains source-supported floating plates and a molten core; T5 alone gains a gemstone heart and rune-halo.
Affinity mineral laminates, compressed sediment joints, crystal load keys, planted dust, and pale fracture lines modify load paths without confusing native stone material with Earth affinity.
counterplay: Cross a widening gap and strike the core shutter before the plates converge. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo, so the loaded sediment key reveals a fracture; T4 floating plates expose its molten core brace; T5 gemstone heart and rune-halo strain one gold-inlaid fault.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating all stone Golems as Earth-affined
identityInvariants: Blocky heavy humanoid construction, oversized hands, small or absent head, blank carved face, and visible joint gaps remain legible.
Clay, fieldstone, iron banding, granite, basalt, marble, gold inlay, and gemstone stay distinct construction materials.
Runes and seam light remain bounded animation hardware rather than generic affinity spectacle.
Workmanship and material quality progress from fingerprints and one scratched rune to sculptural relief and a gemstone heart.
telegraph: Joint gaps widen, plate edges align, and the molten core pulses through the chest cavity.
